node.title: L1 band complement-dimension packing
node.statement: For an exact level-m shell in 2m<=n+k-1, put omega=n-m, w=m-k, and s=omega-w=n-2m+k>=1. The balanced coefficient space has projective dimension s. Distinct codewords have agreement intersection at most k-1, so their omega-element complement root sets intersect in at most s-1 points. Hence Z_m(U)<=floor(binom(n,s)/binom(omega,s)). At linear complement density this is exp(O(s)), paying fixed s and reserve-sublinear s, but it can be exponential at the deployed linear-s frontier.
